entries.title: Ostriv

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Ostriv's current release targets Microsoft Windows, while Linux and Mac are roadmap items. The Early Access release began March 19, 2020, making Windows PC the only playable platform and therefore the complete primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Early Access release on Steam.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC Early Access release.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced current release platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: There is no platform split; Windows PC is the current playable platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: Ostriv remains an Early Access/alpha city builder; Linux and Mac are roadmap platforms, not current releases.
